title: 花旗CEO：AI攻防双线并进 全球企业忙于修补防线
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I can talk for city, we're in two races at the moment.
segments.zh: 就花旗而言，我们目前身处两场竞赛。

segments.en: One is on more of the offense, which is to apply AI, to our product development, to our processes.
segments.zh: 一是进攻端，把AI应用到产品开发和流程中。

segments.en: Obviously, a huge benefits in coding the speed you can do things.
segments.zh: 显然，在编码和提速方面带来巨大好处。

segments.en: And that's really exciting what we're seeing there, particularly on the revenue generation side, because if you have growth, then that's also good for jobs.
segments.zh: 这方面进展令人振奋，尤其在创收端，因为增长对就业也有利。

segments.en: On the second side is the defense. I mean, I have to say when Mythos came out, that was not a good day when we saw the power of the model.
segments.zh: 二是防御端。不得不说，Mythos发布那天可不好过，我们看到了模型的威力。

segments.en: So there is a race to defend and shore up all of the firms perimeters.
segments.zh: 所以，一场防御竞赛正在展开，要加固所有公司的边界。

segments.en: And there is a tsunami of patching going on in the world at the moment in all companies, as we make sure that we are trying to secure the defense
segments.zh: 目前全球所有公司都在进行大量的补丁更新，以确保防御安全。

segments.en: around the parameters of our firms against the negative side of the models.
segments.zh: 围绕公司参数，抵御模型的负面影响。

segments.en: It's too early to know where all the puts and takes will come out.
segments.zh: 现在判断所有利弊得失还为时过早。

segments.en: But you have to be running two races simultaneously.
segments.zh: 但你必须同时跑好这两场竞赛。
